entities.name: PDN DISCONNECT REJECT
entities.description: Network-initiated message sent to reject a PDN disconnect request from the UE.

entities.name: PDN Disconnect Procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by the UE to disconnect from a PDN, which may be rejected by the network.

entities.name: EMM cause
entities.description: Information element included in the PDN DISCONNECT REJECT message indicating the reason for rejection.

relations.description: The PDN disconnect procedure includes the network sending a PDN DISCONNECT REJECT message when rejecting the request.
The PDN DISCONNECT REJECT message contains the EMM cause information element to specify the rejection reason.
